note: The Robex IA panel's map (panel.robexiajd.com), as its server sent it to the page (setZonasVivo over the page's WebSocket), captured read-only from the open page. levels: side (S/R), price, band_low, band_high, toques, independent_rejections, desde, ultimo_toque, tf, origen, quality. With each snapshot, the Coinbase BTC-USD candles it could have seen: closed 15m (300) and 1h (150) bars, then the forming bar built from Coinbase 1m candles up to as_of. Rows: time, open, high, low, close. The server builds its zones on its own live feed and keeps them between updates, so these are for measuring how close the candle-only Map mode gets, not for exact equality. Other coins' maps come from the panel's public /api/moneda/estado endpoint (read with the user's approval, no sign-in), one request per coin at 2026-11-22 00:26 UTC.
